categories.01_primitives: Primitive solids (block, cylinder, sphere, tube, cone/torus via revolve)

categories.04_edge: Edge treatments: constant round, full round, chamfer

categories.07_shell_offset: Shell, offset, thicken, draft, replace/detach faces
